description: A statement of every transfer in a window with each fee broken down, SIGNED by Robyn's relayer key (EIP-191). Use this when you must PROVE to a principal what you spent — your own summary is a claim by the party being audited, but this is verifiable against a published address without trusting you or Robyn. Read `limitations` and repeat them: the statement covers the Robyn float lane only and excludes other rails and the custodial netting book, so it may not be a complete picture of activity.

address.description: restrict to transfers whose record names this sender
